# Bersk Technologies

> Bersk Technologies builds websites, web apps, mobile apps, online stores, custom software and AI automation for businesses and individuals in Nigeria, the United States and online worldwide.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.bersk.tech/): what Bersk does and how the process works
- [Services](https://www.bersk.tech/services): websites, custom software, AI systems and chatbots, business automation, plus FAQs
- [About](https://www.bersk.tech/about): the Lagos-based team behind Bersk and how it works with clients
- [Case Studies](https://www.bersk.tech/case-studies): Galuxe, an online store for Nigerian shoppers
- [Contact](https://www.bersk.tech/contact): book a strategy call
